column2: [intro]
I’ve got sequined sweaters, they’re my pride,
Baggy pants so kitsch, with style I don’t hide.
People stare with eyes full of surprise,
But I’m having fun, catching every eye.
I've got bad taste, it follows me around,
I'm the epitome of a quirky, wild sound.
Of outdated style, I’m so passionate,
But I don’t care, it's my personality, perfect!
I wear extravagant hats, it’s my thing,
Fluorescent tights, I wear like a queen.
Critics shoot glances, say I’m a bit nuts,
But I just smile, enjoy every fuss.
I've got bad taste, it follows me around,
I’m the epitome of a quirky, wild sound.
Of outdated style, I’m so passionate,
But I don’t care, it's my personality, perfect!
[ solo ]
Long live bad taste, let’s all be wild,
Dance endlessly, with no judgments piled.
For it’s in our differences we find our liberty,
Bad taste is our delight, our joyous decree.
[outro]
